title: Bind each case verdict to the declared native test
summary: Make passing assertion evidence specific to the case that requested it. A selected unrelated test must never earn a pass for the declared case.
benefits: Prevents misleading green results in consumer projects
risks: Indicators and selectors differ by native framework

evidence.claim: Before the v0.0.4 release: The current runner can accept the native outcome without tying it to the declared test.
v0.0.4 binds a case verdict to its declared native test using named native outcomes or a verified direct or build-and-run test stage.

decision.reason: Included in the owner-approved publication of Lydite v0.0.4. https://github.com/vixttha/Lydite-Test-Vault-Template/releases/tag/v0.0.4
